scientific_integrity: The full-group integral cycle kernel is proved by a natural cover and equivariant graph-of-spaces equivalence; the direct-sum decomposition presumes a chosen ordered bipartition. No independent audit, experimental-only infinite assertion or fabricated certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one-dimensional complete bipartite graphs with both parts of size at least two; not pure strong complexes, arbitrary bipartite graphs, or ordinary discrete Morse complexes. Originality has residual risk from unindexed literature. Finite tests support but do not replace the uniform proof.
title: Strong Morse complexes of complete bipartite graphs have a canonical doubled-edge cycle lattice
